compiler-rt.cmake:
set(TIZEN_PGO_EXCLUDE_RUNTIMES ON)
set(LLVM_PROFDATA_FILE "/home/linhao/Toolchain/development/llvm-optimize/temp/pgo-profiles-keep-20261102/clang.profdata")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "-O3 -fprofile-instr-use=\"/home/linhao/Toolchain/development/llvm-optimize/temp/pgo-profiles-keep-20261102/clang.profdata\" -g")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "-O3 -fprofile-instr-use=\"/home/linhao/Toolchain/development/llvm-optimize/temp/pgo-profiles-keep-20261102/clang.profdata\" -g")
set(CMAKE_ASM_FLAGS "-O3 -fprofile-instr-use=\"/home/linhao/Toolchain/development/llvm-optimize/temp/pgo-profiles-keep-20261102/clang.profdata\" -g")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "-O3 -fprofile-instr-use=\"/home/linhao/Toolchain/development/llvm-optimize/temp/pgo-profiles-keep-20261102/clang.profdata\" -g")
set(CMAKE_MODULE_LINKER_FLAGS "-O3 -fprofile-instr-use=\"/home/linhao/Toolchain/development/llvm-optimize/temp/pgo-profiles-keep-20261102/clang.profdata\" -g")
set(CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS "-O3 -fprofile-instr-use=\"/home/linhao/Toolchain/development/llvm-optimize/temp/pgo-profiles-keep-20261102/clang.profdata\" -g")
if(TIZEN_PGO_EXCLUDE_RUNTIMES AND LLVM_PROFDATA_FILE)
  foreach(flag_var CMAKE_C_FLAGS CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS CMAKE_ASM_FLAGS
          CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS CMAKE_MODULE_LINKER_FLAGS CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS)
    string(REPLACE "-fprofile-instr-use=\"${LLVM_PROFDATA_FILE}\"" ""
           stripped_flags "${${flag_var}}")
    set(${flag_var} "${stripped_flags}")
  endforeach()
  set(LLVM_PROFDATA_FILE "")
endif()
if(NOT CMAKE_C_FLAGS STREQUAL "-O3  -g")
 message(FATAL_ERROR "CMAKE_C_FLAGS exclusion failed")
endif()
if(NOT CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS STREQUAL "-O3  -g")
 message(FATAL_ERROR "CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS exclusion failed")
endif()
if(NOT CMAKE_ASM_FLAGS STREQUAL "-O3  -g")
 message(FATAL_ERROR "CMAKE_ASM_FLAGS exclusion failed")
endif()
if(NOT CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS STREQUAL "-O3  -g")
 message(FATAL_ERROR "CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS exclusion failed")
endif()
if(NOT CMAKE_MODULE_LINKER_FLAGS STREQUAL "-O3  -g")
 message(FATAL_ERROR "CMAKE_MODULE_LINKER_FLAGS exclusion failed")
endif()
if(NOT CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS STREQUAL "-O3  -g")
 message(FATAL_ERROR "CMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS exclusion failed")
endif()
if(LLVM_PROFDATA_FILE)
 message(FATAL_ERROR "profile path still set")
endif()
